name: Printers - Authorized - Printer Names [is]
description: Intent: Authorized printer names — populate with friendly device names of every corporate-managed printer (e.g., HQ-FloorA-MFP-01, Boston-SecurePrint-Kiosk, Lab-LaserJet-3). Drives the Authorized Printer Activity split on M6000 and is negated in M6010 / W6010 / B6000 to define unauthorized printing. Lower priority unless your org operates a managed print fleet. Exclusions: do not add personal home-office printers or ad-hoc network printers; do not add legacy device names of decommissioned printers — keep the list active.
